messages:
cameron: Heads up 10x H100 lot stalled at ALT-PDX -> carrier says customs X-ray and manifest mismatch.
cameron: This is the RMA tranche we planned for pool-west-burst. If delay >48h we need to re-route or air-split.
vendor-aurora: Apologies 1 we've got the manifest flagged. Causes: missing serial block in the CN23 line and a mismatch in declared commodity description. We can either: 1) update docs in-situ at PDX (24h admin + port handling fee) or 2) diversion to SEA air-hub and air-split to SJC/SFO (expedite, +14% freight).
tara: Cost/ops tradeoff: how much is the PDX in-situ fix vs diversion? Also what's insurance change?
vendor-aurora: PDX document correction: port handling fee $950 flat + $300 admin. No insurance change. Diversion/air-split: freight +14%, handling $420/unit, insurance +0.6% declared.
ops-bot: Ticket created: AUR-2024-8672 "PDX manifest mismatch -> RMA H100 tranche". Assigned to @cameron @tara and vendor-aurora.
cameron: If PDX fix keeps units in the sea manifest we avoid air freight and maintain allocation routing. Prefer that if time ok. Any ETA to clear customs after doc fix?
vendor-aurora: After doc fix, customs X-ray re-review ~812h typical. But if customs decides secondary inspection could add 242h. Not common but possible.
tara: Risk appetite low for live infra. Suggest air-split for 6 critical units, leave 4 to PDX fix. Can vendor produce AWBs and serial map for the 6? Need REDWOOD-RMA tag in manifest ref.
vendor-aurora: Affirmative. We'll generate provisional AWBs and serial mapping. Preliminary AWBs:
```
AWB: 771-0001001
AWB: 771-0001002
AWB: 771-0001003
AWB: 771-0001004
AWB: 771-0001005
AWB: 771-0001006
```
vendor-aurora: We'll also append return labels for 3 DOA units into the manifest refs and link them in the vendor portal. Portal: https://vendor.aurora.example.com/rma?ref=REDWOOD-2024-9001
cameron: Finance please approve conditional air-split for 6 units to SJC. PO to bill: 2024-9177. We want a vendor credit for any PDX demurrage >24h.
ops-bot: Reminder: run allocation_pin after AWB upload. Command snippet:
```
python ops/pool_pin.py --pool pool-west-burst --tag REDWOOD-RMA --awbs 771-0001001,771-0001002,771-0001003,771-0001004,771-0001005,771-0001006
```
customs-bot: Note: when air-splitting from PDX, ensure ECCN on commercial invoice. Also confirm whether units are declared as "complete systems" or "spare modules"; classification affects duty and speed.
tara: Vendor: please confirm commodity declaration matches PO and include serial list in AWB upload. Also provide crate dims/weight so facilities can prep SJC dock.
vendor-aurora: Will upload serial CSV and crate dims within 90m. We will mark AWB refs with REDWOOD-RMA and include RMA return labels.
cameron: OK. If PDX clears quickly we'll cancel air-split and credit freight delta. Vendor to hold off charging until we confirm.
vendor-aurora: Understood. We'll set provisional billing and hold final invoice pending your cancel/confirm.
tara: Thanks everyone. Update thread when AWBs and docs are uploaded. :thumbsup:
